name: Absolute Auction
summary: An English ascending auction with no reserve where the item always sells to the highest bidder.
rules_text: This is an open ascending English auction with no reserve price. One item is offered for sale. Each bidder has a private valuation for the item. An initial low bid or opening price is announced. Bidders then publicly announce increasing bids, each bid must exceed the current high bid by a minimum increment. Bidding continues in turns or openly until no bidder is willing to raise the price. The process guarantees a sale. The bidder who made the final highest bid wins the item and pays the amount of their winning bid, gaining utility equal to their private value minus price paid. All other bidders pay nothing and gain zero.
rating_reason: English auction with no reserve, bidding game
